contract.note: Assessing the contemporaneous plan and distinguishing Plus from other subscriptions fairly tests the claimed dependence. Majority ChatGPT revenue alone cannot establish it.

evidence.note: The reported revenue mix aggregates ChatGPT plans. It establishes neither Plus-specific incremental growth nor the absence of alternative routes to the targets.
